summary.name: MacStories
summary.one_liner: MacStories is an Apple news and app review site by Federico Viticci and John Voorhees, and this page covers upcoming AI and feature updates to Apple Creator Studio.
use_cases: Learning what changed in Apple Creator Studio's November update
Checking Creator Studio pricing and student discounts
Following Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, and Pixelmator Pro news
Reading Apple app news and reviews
Comparing new AI assistant features in Apple productivity apps
summary.what_it_does: The page is a news article on the upcoming biggest update to Apple Creator Studio, released in January, with changes broken down by app. Final Cut Pro and Motion gain MotionVFX tools, including templates, titles, transitions, rotoscoping, tracking, and color grading, plus tighter Pixelmator Pro integration and 23 new transcription languages. Pixelmator Pro gets a Generate Fill feature where users describe an edit and the app generates it. Logic Pro gets a Liquid Glass redesign, a beta AI chatbot assistant, a reorganized Browser, and drum separation in Stem Splitter. Keynote, Pages, and Numbers get a beta AI assistant, MCP support on the Mac, and stock video; Keynote adds a JSON-based interchange format. Freeform gets text styles and background colors, with Pixelmator Pro integration planned for December. The page states Creator Studio costs $12.99/month or $129/year, with student and educator pricing of $2.99/month or $29.99/year.
notable: Covers Apple Creator Studio update with MotionVFX tools built into Final Cut Pro
Keynote, Pages, and Numbers gain MCP support on the Mac for connecting to AI agents
Keynote Interchange Format based on JSON for AI workflows
caveats: Features are announced for November and December and are not yet available at the time of writing
Logic Pro chatbot and Keynote, Pages, Numbers AI assistants are described as beta
Creator Studio is a paid subscription, with a one-month free trial or three months free with qualifying Mac or iPad purchases
